dict.string: This is just a sample. Do NOT try loading it.
Ensure you understand EVERY field before booting.
In most cases recommended to use Sample.plist
Use SampleCustom.plist only for special cases.
HP laptop fake EC + generic USBX; physical runtime untested
PCH a0ed RHUB Darwin-only fallback trial; TXHC control unchanged
GA419 identity-only PC00.GFX0 PNLF, no MMIO
Enable Apple Deep Idle (LPS0/LXEN) and Darwin PEPD (PNP0D80) for S0ixStandby
Override EC0.ITLB/EC12/EC13/ODVP 8-bit split and Darwin PT04 PL4/IccMax fix
Drop OEM SSDT13 HP_XHC_P to fix early RHUB.HS09 AE_NOT_FOUND
PEPD _STA to XSTA in MS-SSDT for S0ixStandby
Rename EC0.ITLB definition to XTLB for 8-bit BFC split
Rename EC0.EC12 definition to XC12 in NVTEC SSDT for 8-bit ACPR split
Rename EC0.EC13 definition to XC13 in NVTEC SSDT for 8-bit BDC/BDV split
Rename IETM.ODVP definition to XDVP in DptfTabl SSDT for 8-bit ACPR/BDC/BDV split
Rename EC0.PT04 definition to XT04 in DSDT to fix DOSS==0 GSWS(0xB6) PL4 clamp
GA47 HP native TGL; offline proposal
VirtualSMC CPU temperature and package power sensors
Pinned Tahoe alpha; AX201 Recovery Wi-Fi experiment, runtime untested
Exact a0ed -> SPT personality only; community-derived, HP runtime untested
Pinned stock 1.1.1 logging/buffer trial; actual HP allocation untested
Intel Tiger Lake cAVS 2.5 SOF DMIC 4-mic array driver
Modern Standby (S0ix) LPS0 _DSM and iGPU wake reset for Deep Idle
